blocks.text: Just over a month before the 2026 Miss Universe coronation night, Bea Millan-Windorski reflected on her reign as Miss Universe Philippines 2026 and pledged to bring the stories of her fellow Filipinos on the international stage. “Para sa komunidad. Para sa kalikasan. Para sa aking bansa,” Millan-Windorski wrote on her Instagram page last Saturday, Oct. 10, alongside portraits of herself wearing her crown. “With less than a month left till I depart for Miss Universe in San Juan, Puerto Rico, I stand with a heart full of gratitude and pride.
